data.one_liner: Scale widget sizes and font sizes using screen percentages with concise extension methods.
data.what_it_does: Provides a singleton ScreenScaler that converts numeric values into screen-relative dimensions and font sizes. Extension getters (.h, .w, .sp) make the API concise.
use_when: You need responsive UI that adapts to different screen sizes
You want to avoid hard‑coded pixel values
You prefer a simple, declarative scaling syntax
avoid_when: You need complex adaptive layouts that depend on breakpoints
You are building a custom layout system that already handles scaling
weaknesses: No breakpoint or adaptive layout support
No built‑in theming or advanced layout features
data.setup_notes: Call ScreenScaler.init(context) once (e.g., in the root widget). No permissions or build_runner needed.
